assertions.assertion: The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is I48.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code for personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction is Z86.73
